description: On the bed in front of you there’s a small stack of colorful bowls against a pink pillow. The right hand reaches in, lifts the top light-blue bowl off the stack and sets it down to the right, then lifts the orange bowl and places it in front, and finally picks up a teal bowl and sets it down to the left so the bowls are unstacked and spread out; the left hand stays low on the bed without touching the bowls.
